envelope.title: D-116 · Use one acceptance record per release
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-116 is about Consultant Scheduling: use one acceptance record per release so retries cannot record duplicate approval.
